scenarios.target_behavior: Timely micro-loan repayment within 14 days of disbursement
scenarios.target_audience: Female market vendors and informal food stall operators
scenarios.baseline_message: Dear customer, your loan repayment is due soon. Avoid penalties and interest charges.
scenarios.diagnosed_friction: High cognitive load, cashflow volatility, and penalty threat inducing reactance
scenarios.redesigned_mechanism: Loss aversion on future credit line + 1-tap USSD default architecture

scenarios.target_behavior: Completing 4 Antenatal Care (ANC) visits and newborn immunization
scenarios.target_audience: First-time mothers and young expectant families
scenarios.baseline_message: Health is wealth. Visit the clinic every month for your baby's immunizations.
scenarios.diagnosed_friction: Ambiguous scheduling, clinic wait sludge, reliance on male household head permission
scenarios.redesigned_mechanism: Morning-of SMS prompts + in-kind delivery pack incentive framing

scenarios.target_behavior: Purchasing hybrid seed and basal fertilizer at post-harvest liquidity peak
scenarios.target_audience: Smallholder maize farmers managing subsistence acreage
scenarios.baseline_message: Use quality fertilizer at planting time to double your crop yield.
scenarios.diagnosed_friction: Temporal discounting; cash reserves spent during lean season before planting time
scenarios.redesigned_mechanism: SAFI post-harvest pre-commitment vouchers with delayed free delivery

scenarios.target_behavior: Maintaining personal mobile money PIN privacy and secret savings accumulation
scenarios.target_audience: Women micro-entrepreneurs living in extended kin households
scenarios.baseline_message: Keep your mobile money PIN secret for financial security.
scenarios.diagnosed_friction: Social tax from relatives and partners demanding phone inspection
scenarios.redesigned_mechanism: Discreet biometric secondary lock-box with neutral generic confirmation SMS

scenarios.target_behavior: Paying annual market stall levy via local government digital portal
scenarios.baseline_message: Tax evasion is a crime under Section 42. Pay your stall fee immediately.
scenarios.diagnosed_friction: Low institutional trust; zero perceived public good reciprocity
scenarios.redesigned_mechanism: Visible reciprocity attribution (linking levies to market security and refuse clearing)

scenarios.target_behavior: Primary school teachers delivering daily 45-minute leveled reading interventions
scenarios.baseline_message: Teachers must strictly follow the foundational literacy curriculum timetable.
scenarios.diagnosed_friction: Curriculum overload; teachers teaching to grade rather than learning level
scenarios.redesigned_mechanism: Teaching at the Right Level (TaRL) peer cohort recognition + weekly bite-sized SMS guides

scenarios.target_behavior: Treating collected borehole drinking water with dilute chlorine solution
scenarios.baseline_message: Boil or chlorinate all drinking water to prevent diarrhea and cholera.
scenarios.diagnosed_friction: Taste aversion, fuel cost for boiling, delay between collection and consumption
scenarios.redesigned_mechanism: Free point-of-collection chlorine dispensers making treatment visible and effortless

scenarios.target_behavior: Enrolling in parametric satellite drought index micro-insurance
scenarios.baseline_message: Insure your herd against drought disaster for KSh 1,500.
scenarios.diagnosed_friction: Ambiguity aversion; distrust of insurance payouts and claims processes
scenarios.redesigned_mechanism: Bundled opt-out seed purchase insurance + automatic mobile money satellite trigger

scenarios.target_behavior: Completing daily vehicle safety inspection and logging shift hours
scenarios.baseline_message: Safety first: inspect your brakes and tires before opening the driver app.
scenarios.diagnosed_friction: Bandwidth tax; high urgency to accept early morning rides immediately
scenarios.redesigned_mechanism: 3-question pictorial USSD micro-check with streak rewards for maintenance

scenarios.target_behavior: Reporting extortion and illegal transit checkpoints via anonymous channel
scenarios.baseline_message: Report police and union extortion to the anti-corruption hotline.
scenarios.diagnosed_friction: Retaliation fear; cynicism that complaints lead to no administrative consequence
scenarios.redesigned_mechanism: Anonymous WhatsApp voice memo with automated tracking ticket number and union peer shield
